meta.name: derisk-measurement-advisor
meta.description: Identify what to measure, test, or track to de-risk a product or AI idea. Use when stress-testing an idea across internal (DUFV) and external (PESTEL) dimensions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确定要测量与跟踪的指标,让产品想法风险可控
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在验证新产品或 AI 想法的可行性
copy.tagline_en: Decide what to measure to reduce risk of your product idea
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're validating a new product or AI idea

howto.what: 引导你把产品或AI想法放进10个风险维度里检查(4个内部:被需要、好用、能造、赚钱;6个外部:政治、经济、社会、技术、环境、法律),要求你对每个风险选「立即行动」或「持续跟踪」,最后给出按优先级排好的风险清单。
howto.when: 当你把一个具体的产品或AI想法(哪怕一句话)交给它,想在做决定前看看哪里可能出问题、该测什么、该跟踪什么时,顾问就会启动10个维度的扫描。

say.text: 帮我检查这个AI想法:自动起草保险理赔回复的智能助手,目前只有原型。
say.note: 顾问会逐条扫内部与外部风险,让你给每个风险定处置方式。

say.text: 用「Context dump」模式,我把已知的情况都贴给你,然后开始。
say.note: 此模式会跳过已覆盖的内容,只补问缺口。

say.text: 这个产品准备上路,帮我把风险分成「立即行动」和「持续跟踪」。
say.note: 最后会给你一份按优先级排好的风险登记册。

howto.what_en: Guides you through a 10-dimension risk scan (4 internal: is it wanted, usable, buildable, profitable; 6 external: political, economic, social, technological, environmental, legal), asks you to mark each risk as act-now or watch, and ends with a prioritized risk register.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give it a concrete product or AI idea (even a sentence) and want to check what could go wrong before committing, or what to measure, test, or track.

say_en.text: Scan this: AI agent auto-drafts insurance claim replies; prototype only.
say_en.note: Scan walks 10 dimensions, applying act/watch triage to risks.

say_en.text: Use context-dump mode — I'll paste what we know; start.
say_en.note: Skips covered info and fills only missing context.

say_en.text: Product ships soon: sort risks into act-now vs keep-watching.
